'''Zyluria''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Zyluria system/Legends|Zyluria system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Carsanza system/Legends|Carsanza system]]. Zyluria's surface featured gentle plains, and it was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Zylurian]]s, a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that,<ref name="TEA" /> by [[43 ABY]],<ref name="date">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which includes a description of Zyluria, ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of that novel to [[43 ABY]].</ref> had long served the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the Senex-Juvex.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zyluria was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
